job.title: Accounts Manager
job.description:
Frustrated by doing technically solid work but feeling overlooked?

You’re a qualified accountant (ACCA/ACA), with post-qualification experience, ready to move beyond report preparation into leading client relationships and guiding teammates. If you've ever thought, “I need more responsibility and recognition,” this role might be the answer.

✨ Why This Is Your Next Step
  • Own a client portfolio: You'll manage accounts, tax returns, and financial closes end-to-end—meeting with clients and shaping how their businesses are run.
  • Lead and mentor: Empower juniors and seniors through guidance, coaching, and feedback—helping them flourish as you rise.
  • Be an advisor: Spot opportunities for clients to benefit from AMS Group’s full-service advisory suite, collaborating closely with business directors.
  • Balanced and respected: Based in Manchester, you’ll enjoy hybrid flexibility, professional benefits, and a company culture built around well-being and development.

🧭 What You’ll Bring (and What That Means for You)
  • Strong technical grounding: ACCA/ACA qualified with 3+ years PQE in UK practice—comfortable with FRS102 (Sections 1A, 105) and consolidation work.
  • Client-first attitude: You enjoy liaising with clients, managing their diaries, and ensuring quality is never compromised.
  • Leadership mindset: You’re ready to mentor others—and to show commercial insight by reviewing fees and recommending adjustments when needed.
  • Deep interest in advisory: You see the value in cross-selling tax, corporate finance, or advisory services—benefiting clients and career progression.

💷 What’s In It for You
  • Salary of £45–55k—in line with roles in Manchester that typically pay £40–50k for senior/accounts assistant manager grades, and approaching upper-mid practice manager levels cited on Reddit as £55k+ bonus .
  • Full benefits: 25 days holiday (+birthday), bonus potential, health cash plan, Perkbox, cycle-to-work scheme, paid study membership, pension, long-term parental pay, and EAP support.
  • Development opportunities: Work under the Accounts Director with direct line responsibility, gain exposure to multiple advisory lines, and lead project work.
  • Culture that cares: AMS Group reports 98% client satisfaction and 88% employee satisfaction—with a focus on continuous learning and work-life balance.

🎯 What Success Looks Like
  • Seamless accounts and tax delivery from prep to sign-off—on time and within budget.
  • A trusted client point of contact, comfortable leading meetings and managing expectations.
  • Positive team outcomes—juniors growing under your guidance and steady, proactive communication with your manager.
  • Commercial insight: you raise fee reviews when needed and thoughtfully suggest advisory solutions.

🚀 Ready to Shape Your Career?

If you’re driven to step into a role where leadership, client engagement, and technical excellence matter—and you want a platform that rewards you accordingly—let’s start a conversation.

Curious? Send a quick note or your CV. Let’s talk about how this could be your next career home—no strings attached.

📍 Location: Manchester (hybrid after probation)
💼 Salary: £45,000–£55,000 + bonus + benefits
👇 Drop us a message to explore—this might be the step forward you’ve been waiting for.

job.title: Audit Senior
job.description:
Tired of routine audits and ready for something more engaging?

You’ve spent the last 12–24 months in UK audit, supporting teams, talking to clients, and building technical skills. Now you’re looking for a role where you can grow, lead others, and make real impact. If you're ACA/ACCA qualified, this role is built for someone just like you.

🌟 Here's What You'll Be Doing
  • Own the audit journey: Plan, test, and complete audits for SMEs and charities—making every engagement count.
  • Build and guide your team: Train and mentor assistants, offering feedback and support so they learn and succeed.
  • Take ownership: Report directly to the Audit Manager and get involved in other assignments—FDD, cashflow modeling, or tax prep—if you choose.
  • Shape your skillset: Prepare financial statements and corporation tax computations when you want to level up.

✅ What You Bring (and Why It Matters)
  • 12–24 months’ audit experience—you’re technically sound and eager to take on wider responsibility.
  • ACA or ACCA qualified—ready to build real audit authority and influence.
  • Confident communicator—you speak openly with clients, managers, and peers with clarity and assurance.
  • Detail-focused and curious—you notice what others might miss and look for the “why” behind the numbers.
  • Tech-ready attitude—CCH and Alphatax? Great—but most importantly, you're ready to learn.

🎯 What Success Looks Like
  • Audits are delivered smoothly, on time, and to high standards.
  • Juniors report clear guidance and real growth—they’re better for working with you.
  • You’re comfortable stepping into new tasks—from tax to forecasts—stretching yourself beyond audit.
  • You're in a rhythm with your manager, progressing naturally toward senior responsibility.

💷 Salary & Market Insight
  • Competitive Manchester salary: £33k–£52k, with an average around £41k, plus an additional £3k bonus—perfectly aligned with current market rates for audit seniors
  • You’ll also enjoy 25 days’ leave, hybrid-flexible working, and tailored training.

🌱 Why This Should Be Your Next Move
  • Variety, without chaos: Work across sectors, assignments, and with genuine opportunities to stretch.
  • Training that sticks: You’ll benefit from hands-on in-house learning, not just tick-box modules.
  • Support, not pressure: Flexible, hybrid working helps you balance focus and life outside the office.
  • Pathway to promotion: Showcase your growing skills and leadership—you’ll be ready for the next level before you know it.

🚀 Ready to Level Up?

If you're ready to transition from routine audits to leading engagements, mentoring emerging talent, and engaging confidently with clients, this role could be the step you've been looking for.

Let’s start with a relaxed chat—no expectation to apply—just a conversation about where you're headed next.

📍 Location: Manchester (hybrid-flexible)
💼 Salary: £33,000–£52,000 base + bonus + benefits
👇 Interested? Drop a message or send your CV—this could be the next milestone in your career.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:

To help continue the company’s growth, our client is looking for an experienced finance manager to join their finance team.

  • Supervise financial reporting and operations, cash flow analysis and balance sheet management
  • Handling Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable functions
  • Facilitating and processing the full spectrum of payroll function and benefit claims monthly
  • Preparing of monthly Balance Sheet Schedules and Bank Reconciliations
  • Preparation of monthly financial reports in a timely and accurate manner in accordance with the Company's requirements reporting directly to the CEO
  • Compiling regular GST returns, financial statements, and taxation returns
  • Supporting and recruiting finance assistants
  • Any other ad-hoc duties as assigned

ABOUT YOU
  • 5+ years of experience in a simila`
  • Strong proficiency in all aspects of corporate accounting
  • Fully chartered accountant (CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent)
  • Ability to develop and implement effective fiscal/accounting policies and financial controls
  • Strong record in a management role 
  • A positive working attitude including willingness to work longer hours during peak periods

WHAT WE OFFER

We provide a work environment and culture that value excellent leadership, professional advancement, and challenging, stimulating work. Salary range $115,000-$150,000 (salary and benefits will be competitive and commensurate with experience)

job.title: Radiographer
job.description:
Location: Various Locations Across Australia

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary: $130,000 – $170,000 per year

This full-time position involves performing X-ray, CT, and mammography scans, ensuring high-quality patient care, and assisting Radiologists with interventional procedures. Collaboration with clerical staff, technical staff, Radiologists, and referrers is essential to deliver exceptional medical imaging services.

  • Assist Radiologists during interventional procedures.
  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including clerical and technical staff, Radiologists, and referrers.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Current AHPRA registration and EPA Radiation Licence.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

  • Compensation: Industry-competitive salary and benefits package; annual remuneration review; generous on-call retainer and call-out rates; relocation allowance to assist with your move.

Join us in providing outstanding medical imaging services across Australia. Apply today!

job.title: Credit Control Officer/Credit Controller
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an Australian group who operate businesses in media and advertising sector. With over 1,000 colleagues operating in 50 offices across the country, they use powerful advertising through PR, marketing strategy, social media, and influencers to spread their message and overall image.

As part of their expansion, our client is seeking someone who has a passion for start-ups and who can oversee the implementation of creative campaigns to generate leads, pipeline, and ultimately increased revenue.


THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role, you will be working within our close-knit Finance team. A Credit Controller must have excellent communication, customer service, and stakeholder management abilities to manage debts and reduce past-due and high-risk loans. You will be:

  • Monitoring overdraft and delinquent accounts to make sure that future payments are made
  • Aiding in the upkeep of agreements reached in the Debtor Management System
  • Regulating a large volume ledger, maintaining debtor information, and keeping an eye on credit limitations
  • Reconcile intricate finances while paying close attention to details.
  • Internally monitor and manage credit limits with the proper staff
  • Reconciling extensive accounting and having a keen eye for detail
  • Giving professional advice in response to inquiries by identifying the best answers
  • Restricting account access when necessary

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys interacting with customers, strengthens positive relationships, has the skills to handle customer problems, and takes satisfaction in achieving goals.

ABOUT YOU

To be qualified for this role, a Credit Control Officer is someone who:

  • Has a solid background in credit control 
  • Is a strong communicator and highly organised
  • Enjoys a challenge and has experience working on more complex billings having used a medium to large ERP system
  • Is a professional with strong work ethic and a preference for corporate environments

Qualifications:

  • More than 3 years of financial work experience, experienced in accountant or financial supervisor is preferred.
  • Bachelors in accounting or diploma (Bachelors is preferred)
  • High-class verbal and written communication skills
  • Basic software such as Xero, Excel, etc.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Full-time, permanent opportunity
  • Flexible hybrid working environment
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses
  • Ongoing training and professional development

job.title: Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

A well-known multinational construction and property business with expanding domestic operations and one of the best-performing divisions locally, with over eight $1 million+ brands and global sales of approximately $20 billion. The clients’ brands are truly global, with goods being manufactured and sold in more than 50 nations.

A close-knit, vibrant, and professional business culture takes pride in ensuring that working is a fulfilling and supportive experience. If you are prepared to shape the future and leave a legacy, join our team as an Accounts Receivable Officer.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Accounts Receivable Officer will be responsible for the company’s accounts receivable transactions and debt recovery. Previous experience in accounts receivable is essential. Experience in a construction company would be an advantage.

Key tasks and responsibilities:

●     Daily & weekly billing runs
●     Managing email & phone-based queries
●     Daily Forecast (Actuals vs Forecast) reporting
●     Running of receivable reports
●     Follow up on current and overdue accounts
●     End of month duties
●     Investigating and resolving queries relation to non-payment
●    Account reconciliations/Ledgers/Debt Collection & Allocations
●     Time efficiency
●     Working to monthly and annually collections targets
●     General admin support and data entry

ABOUT YOU:
 
●     Three years minimum of equivalent experience within the Construction industry or Credit Control/Accounts Receivable
●     Prior knowledge of end-to-end receivables
●     Proficient with Salesforce
●     Solid UK based Credit Control/Accounts experience
●     Methodical worker and calm under pressure
●     Strong attention to detail and accuracy
●     Excellent verbal and written communication skills
●     Ability to multi-task and to meet deadlines
●     Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential
●     Ability to work co-operatively and effectively as part of a team/autonomously

WHAT WE OFFER

Our client is always on the lookout for great people. People who are driven, ambitious, have a track record of success, and are skilled at what they do. Benefits include:
 
●     Flexible working arrangements
●     Opportunities to grow your career
●     Private health insurance and wellness programs
●     Salary (90,000-105,000 based on experience)

job.title: Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

A reputable and well-known fashion retail brand with over 50+ retail stores as well as distribution centers throughout UK. We are a people-centered business with more than 5,000 team employees across our locations.

Our client takes great delight in offering high-quality items and has a track record of steady expansion and is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Officer.

THE OPPORTUNITY

A team of 10 people includes an Accounts Receivable Officer who reports to the Finance Manager.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Daily processing of all bank receipts ensuring accurate and complete allocation of all customer and general ledger receipts.
  • Ensuring resolution of any query or short payment by a customer is resolved in a timely manner.
  • Ensuring customer statements are issued on a regular monthly basis to minimize arrears.
  • Ensuring invoices for “non-standard” charges and cost recoveries are timely so there is efficient financial reporting and customer payment.
  • Ensuring customer credit notes and refunds are valid, authorized and processed in a timely manner.
  • Managing and processing receipts across various companies, including intercompany receipts.
  • Processing EFTPOS and Credit Card payments.
  • Addressing and responding to customer inquiries and following up as required with internal staff.
  • Reconciliation of customer accounts and follow-up where required.
  • Providing weekly performance reports of accounts receivable process.
  • Managing the monthly reconciliation of control accounts.

ABOUT YOU

You'll be someone who enjoys a challenge, takes pleasure in producing accurate and high-quality work, and has the shown capacity to manage a heavy workload. You'll bring a positive attitude and the ability to learn & adapt quickly.

Skills and Experience required:

  • 2-3 years accounts receivable or general accounting experience.
  • Experience in working within high volume environments
  • Knowledge of relevant accounting software
  • An understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting skills.
  • Proficient Microsoft Office knowledge and skills.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • High degree of attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.
  • Ability to meet deadlines.
  • Exceptional communication skills both verbal and written

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Positive and safe workplace culture and environment
  • Competitive salary (80,000-100,000) and compensation based on experience
  • Professional development and career development opportunities

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is a non-profit organization that equips ordinary UKns to change the through advocacy, development, and humanitarian efforts. Our client is a renowned non-profit organization that serves citizens across 130 locations and has made it their top mission to offer care for the elderly and assistance to the vulnerable.

To help grow and enhance the finance processes of the company, our client is looking for an experienced Assistant Accountant to fill a full-time position.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Joining their growing finance team, you'll take responsibility for the full AR/AP function and assist on EOM/BAS reporting. All other tasks include, but not limited to:

  • Accounts Payable and Receivable Management
  • Assisting with balance sheet reconciliation
  • Preparing GST returns
  • Daily reconciliation of sales to banking and bank reconciliations for all entities
  • Fortnightly payroll and manual pay, as required
  • Maintaining fixed assets register and annual review
  • Maintaining staff accounts
  • Updating cashflow report on a weekly basis which includes updating for future import orders
  • Preparing Monthly retail reports

ABOUT YOU

The successful applicant will preferably have:

  • Tertiary qualification in Business/Accounting
  • Sound knowledge of accounting/bookkeeping processes
  • At least 2 years’ experience in Assistant Accounting roles
  • Previous experience in supporting month-end closing, as well as general reporting
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • A high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Salary Package: 70k + benefits

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is a multinational Technology Firm expanding rapidly in the APAC region, centered around UK. Recently acquired by a major parent company and have plans to expand operations significantly in the next 5 years.

They are amid a period of expansion and growth and are searching for a driven and competent Finance Manager to join their modest team. They aim to continue growing with a domestic and worldwide presence. Our client is committed in nurturing and encouraging employees that allow them to reach their best potential in all facets of life.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a member of a finance team, you will work in a contemporary office setting. You have a fantastic opportunity to advance your career in finance with the continuous training programs of the company. Candidates with extensive experience in transactional finance would be particularly suitable for this position.

Your new role...

As finance manager, you will assist and support the executive management team in making the best choices for the company by providing financial information and counsel. Your principal duties will include but are not limited to:

  • Management Accounts – Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet on a timely basis
  • Annual Tax Accounts & reviewing Tax Computation/Deductibility
  • Accounts Payables including the Full Cycle of all related Documents
  • Accounts Receivables
  • Management and oversight of all accounting and treasury functions,
  • Preparation of budgets and forecasts,
  • Managing Key Performance Indexes (KPI)
  • Staff Training & Appraisal other than managing the subordinates
  • Interpreting the company's financial results to Management

ABOUT YOU

Our ideal Candidate will have the following:

  • Professional qualifications such as CA, CPA, ACCA, or CIMA
  • Proven experience in the role of Finance Manager
  • Solid knowledge of basic and advanced accounting and financial principles and practices.
  • Experience at leading and managing direct reports
  • Strong administration and process improvement skills
  • Ability to analyze data, develop reports and undertake regular reporting, and provide insights and recommendations to management

Salary Package: 115k + benefits

job.title: Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is a well-known and established leader in the media and advertising sector and has been operating for 20 years with over 100 offices and 5,000+ staff all over the country. With global presence and a passion for continuous investment in innovation, our client is now seeking an Accounts Receivable Officer to join their team of high performing Finance Executives.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As the Accounts Receivable Officer, reporting to Chief Financial Officer and Finance Manager, you will be responsible for both the beginning phases of the debt collection process and the entire receivables department. Among the responsibilities are:

  • Daily processing of all bank receipts ensuring accurate and complete allocation of all customer and general ledger receipts.
  • Addressing and responding to customer inquiries and following up as required with internal staff.
  • Reconciliation of customer accounts and follow up where required.
  • Providing weekly performance reports of accounts receivable process.
  • Managing the monthly reconciliation of control accounts.
  • Follow up overdue invoices for allocated customer accounts
  • Process the receipt of customers payments in the accounting systems
  • Provide Ageing reports of overdue payments to Finance manager on daily, weekly, monthly basis
  • Any ad hoc as required by the Management

ABOUT YOU
﻿
  • 2+ years experience in a similar role.
  • Diploma / Certificate / Tertiary qualifications in Commerce or Accounting
  • Prior experience in financial roles is desirable
  • Experience in working within high volume environments
  • Knowledge of relevant accounting software
  • Proficient English communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work under pressure
  • Fluent in English – both written and spoken
  • Ability to work towards a deadline
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
  • Full working rights in UK

Salary Package: 80k + benefits

job.title: Credit Control Officer/Credit Controller
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an UKn group who operates businesses in the media and advertising sector. With over 1,000 colleagues operating in 50 offices across the country, they use powerful advertising through PR, marketing strategy, social media, and influencers to spread their message and overall image.

As part of their expansion, our client is seeking someone who has a passion for start-ups and who can oversee the implementation of creative campaigns to generate leads, pipeline, and ultimately increase revenue.


THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role, you will be working within our close-knit Finance team. A Credit Controller must have excellent communication, customer service, and stakeholder management abilities to manage debts and reduce past-due and high-risk loans. You will be:

  • Monitoring overdraft and delinquent accounts to make sure that future payments are made
  • Aiding in the upkeep of agreements reached in the Debtor Management System
  • Regulating a large volume ledger, maintaining debtor information, and keeping an eye on credit limitations
  • Reconcile intricate finances while paying close attention to details.
  • Internally monitor and manage credit limits with the proper staff
  • Reconciling extensive accounting and having a keen eye for detail
  • Giving professional advice in response to inquiries by identifying the best answers
  • Restricting account access when necessary

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys interacting with customers, strengthens positive relationships, has the skills to handle customer problems, and takes satisfaction in achieving goals.

ABOUT YOU
To be qualified for this role, a Credit Control Officer is someone who:

  • Has a solid background in credit control
  • Is a strong communicator and highly organised
  • Enjoys a challenge and has experience working on more complex billings having used a medium to large ERP system
  • Is a professional with strong work ethic and a preference for corporate environments

Qualifications:

  • More than 3 years of financial work experience, experienced in accountant or financial supervisor is preferred.
  • Bachelors in accounting or diploma (Bachelors is preferred)

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an established and reputable global leader in the technology industry. The client has a high-performance culture and operates from prestige offices located in the London CBD with over 100+ staff. The client's innovative business-to-user strategy is centred on creating technology that is simple to use with solutions that encourage innovation and provide users with productivity that is unparalleled in the industry.

With the growing demand for driving advancements in technology, our client is currently seeking a highly motivated Assistant Accountant to join their supportive & high-achieving Finance team.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The purpose of your role is to provide support & assistance for the finance manager and finance team with all bookkeeping and data entry for account preparation.

Key Duties Include:

  • Action daily enquiries from customers and staff, face to face and by phone/email.
  • Open, action and circulate daily mail.
  • Daily bank account reconciliations.
  • Oversee preparation, payment, reconciliation, and payment of fortnightly payroll.
  • Processing supplier invoices and mailing/emailing statements.
  • Reconciliation of intercompany balances.
  • Processing suppliers' foreign exchange requirements.
  • Preparation of reports required under the company's FCPA reporting requirements.
  • Opening and maintenance of debtors' and creditors' master file accounts.
  • Preparation and posting of monthly accounting journals.
  • Reconciliation of high-risk balance sheet accounts.
  • Preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly draft accounting reports.

ABOUT YOU

The successful applicant will preferably have:

  • A Tertiary degree in Accounting
  • At least 12 months of experience in Assistant Accounting roles
  • Previous experience in supporting month-end closing, as well as general reporting
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • A high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Salary Package: 70k + benefits

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an UKn group who operate businesses in renewable and sustainability sector with 30 offices and 10,000+ staff in the country. Our client is constantly evolving through the years, extending, and updating their range of resources to make them more dependable, useful, and cost-effective. As our client continues to demonstrate, no one should ever be compelled to choose between economical, dependable, or sustainable energy.

To help grow and enhance the finance processes of the company, our client is looking for an experienced Assistant Accountant to fill a full-time position.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Joining their growing finance team, you'll take responsibility for the full AR/AP function and assist on EOM/BAS reporting. All other tasks include, but not limited to:

  • Accounts Payable and Receivable Management
  • Assisting with balance sheet reconciliation
  • Preparing GST returns
  • Daily reconciliation of sales to banking and bank reconciliations for all entities
  • Fortnightly payroll and manual pay, as required
  • Maintaining fixed assets register and annual review
  • Maintaining staff accounts
  • Updating cashflow report on a weekly basis which includes updating for future import orders
  • Preparing Monthly retail reports

ABOUT YOU

The successful applicant will preferably have:

  • Tertiary qualification in Business/Accounting
  • Sound knowledge of accounting/bookkeeping processes
  • At least 2 years’ experience in Assistant Accounting roles
  • Previous experience in supporting month-end closing, as well as general reporting
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • A high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Salary Package: $70k + benefits

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

One of the nation’s leading healthcare providers, our client is highly successful in the healthcare industry which specialises in providing exceptional service to the community. Our client is currently going through a time of tremendous growth and needs a Financial Controller to join the company.

THE OPPORTUNITY

A Finance Controller’s primary responsibility manage the Full Finance Spectrum and day-to-day activities of the finance functions of our entities ensuring efficient and accurate financial and management accounts.  You will assist with budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning and analysis. 

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide practicable solutions to improving related internal control and risk management
  • Provide timely and accurate month end closing and reports

  • Possesses high level understanding of accounting principles, auditing, and taxation compliance of UK
  • Strong leadership skill.

job.title: Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

A reputable and well-known fashion retail brand with over 50+ retail stores as well as distribution centers throughout UK. We are a people-centered business with more than 5,000 team employees across our locations.

Our client takes great delight in offering high-quality items and has a track record of steady expansion and is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Officer.

THE OPPORTUNITY

A team of 10 people includes an Accounts Receivable Officer who reports to the Finance Manager.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Daily processing of all bank receipts ensuring accurate and complete allocation of all customer and general ledger receipts.
  • Ensuring resolution of any query or short payment by a customer is resolved in a timely manner.
  • Ensuring customer statements are issued on a regular monthly basis to minimize arrears.
  • Ensuring invoices for “non-standard” charges and cost recoveries are timely so there is efficient financial reporting and customer payment.
  • Ensuring customer credit notes and refunds are valid, authorized and processed in a timely manner.
  • Managing and processing receipts across various companies, including intercompany receipts.
  • Processing EFTPOS and Credit Card payments.
  • Addressing and responding to customer inquiries and following up as required with internal staff.
  • Reconciliation of customer accounts and follow-up where required.
  • Providing weekly performance reports of accounts receivable process.
  • Managing the monthly reconciliation of control accounts.

ABOUT YOU

You'll be someone who enjoys a challenge, takes pleasure in producing accurate and high-quality work, and has the shown capacity to manage a heavy workload. You'll bring a positive attitude and the ability to learn & adapt quickly.

Skills and Experience required:

  • 2-3 years accounts receivable or general accounting experience.
  • Experience in working within high volume environments
  • Knowledge of relevant accounting software
  • An understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting skills.
  • Proficient Microsoft Office knowledge and skills.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • High degree of attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.
  • Ability to meet deadlines.
  • Exceptional communication skills both verbal and written

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Positive and safe workplace culture and environment
  • Competitive salary ($80,000-&100,000) and compensation based on experience
  • Professional development and career development opportunities

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is a multinational Technology Firm expanding rapidly in the APAC region, centered around UK. Recently acquired by a major parent company and have plans to expand operations significantly in the next 5 years.

They are amid a period of expansion and growth and are searching for a driven and competent Finance Manager to join their modest team. They aim to continue growing with a domestic and worldwide presence. Our client is committed in nurturing and encouraging employees that allow them to reach their best potential in all facets of life.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a member of a finance team, you will work in a contemporary office setting. You have a fantastic opportunity to advance your career in finance with the continuous training programs of the company. Candidates with extensive experience in transactional finance would be particularly suitable for this position.

Your new role...

As finance manager, you will assist and support the executive management team in making the best choices for the company by providing financial information and counsel. Your principal duties will include but are not limited to:

  • Management Accounts – Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet on a timely basis
  • Annual Tax Accounts & reviewing Tax Computation/Deductibility
  • Accounts Payables including the Full Cycle of all related Documents
  • Accounts Receivables
  • Management and oversight of all accounting and treasury functions,
  • Preparation of budgets and forecasts,
  • Managing Key Performance Indexes (KPI)
  • Staff Training & Appraisal other than managing the subordinates
  • Interpreting the company's financial results to Management

ABOUT YOU

Our ideal Candidate will have the following:

  • Professional qualifications such as CA, CPA, ACCA, or CIMA
  • Proven experience in the role of Finance Manager
  • Solid knowledge of basic and advanced accounting and financial principles and practices.
  • Experience at leading and managing direct reports
  • Strong administration and process improvement skills
  • Ability to analyze data, develop reports and undertake regular reporting, and provide insights and recommendations to management

Salary Package: $115k + benefits

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an established and reputable global leader in the technology industry. The client has a high-performance culture and operates from prestige offices located in the London CBD with over 100+ staff. The client's innovative business-to-user strategy is centred on creating technology that is simple to use with solutions that encourage innovation and provide users with productivity that is unparalleled in the industry.

With the growing demand for driving advancements in technology, our client is currently seeking a highly motivated Assistant Accountant to join their supportive & high-achieving Finance team.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The purpose of your role is to provide support & assistance for the finance manager and finance team with all bookkeeping and data entry for account preparation.

Key Duties Include:

  • Action daily enquiries from customers and staff, face to face and by phone/email.
  • Open, action and circulate daily mail.
  • Daily bank account reconciliations.
  • Oversee preparation, payment, reconciliation, and payment of fortnightly payroll.
  • Processing supplier invoices and mailing/emailing statements.
  • Reconciliation of intercompany balances.
  • Processing suppliers' foreign exchange requirements.
  • Preparation of reports required under the company's FCPA reporting requirements.
  • Opening and maintenance of debtors' and creditors' master file accounts.
  • Preparation and posting of monthly accounting journals.
  • Reconciliation of high-risk balance sheet accounts.
  • Preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly draft accounting reports.

ABOUT YOU

The successful applicant will preferably have:

  • A Tertiary degree in Accounting
  • At least 12 months of experience in Assistant Accounting roles
  • Previous experience in supporting month-end closing, as well as general reporting
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

job.title: Credit Control Officer/Credit Controller
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an UKn group who operates businesses in the media and advertising sector. With over 1,000 colleagues operating in 50 offices across the country, they use powerful advertising through PR, marketing strategy, social media, and influencers to spread their message and overall image.

As part of their expansion, our client is seeking someone who has a passion for start-ups and who can oversee the implementation of creative campaigns to generate leads, pipeline, and ultimately increase revenue.


THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role, you will be working within our close-knit Finance team. A Credit Controller must have excellent communication, customer service, and stakeholder management abilities to manage debts and reduce past-due and high-risk loans. You will be:

  • Monitoring overdraft and delinquent accounts to make sure that future payments are made
  • Aiding in the upkeep of agreements reached in the Debtor Management System
  • Regulating a large volume ledger, maintaining debtor information, and keeping an eye on credit limitations
  • Reconcile intricate finances while paying close attention to details.
  • Internally monitor and manage credit limits with the proper staff
  • Reconciling extensive accounting and having a keen eye for detail
  • Giving professional advice in response to inquiries by identifying the best answers
  • Restricting account access when necessary

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys interacting with customers, strengthens positive relationships, has the skills to handle customer problems, and takes satisfaction in achieving goals.

ABOUT YOU
To be qualified for this role, a Credit Control Officer is someone who:

  • Has a solid background in credit control
  • Is a strong communicator and highly organised
  • Enjoys a challenge and has experience working on more complex billings having used a medium to large ERP system
  • Is a professional with strong work ethic and a preference for corporate environments

Qualifications:

  • More than 3 years of financial work experience, experienced in accountant or financial supervisor is preferred.
  • Bachelors in accounting or diploma (Bachelors is preferred)
  • High-class verbal and written communication skills
  • Basic software such as Xero, Excel, etc.


WHAT WE OFFER
﻿
  • Full-time, permanent opportunity
  • Flexible hybrid working environment
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Salary package: $90k Package + Benefits

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is a non-profit organization that equips ordinary Australians to change the through advocacy, development, and humanitarian efforts. Our client is a renowned non-profit organization that serves citizens across 130 locations and has made it their top mission to offer care for the elderly and assistance to the vulnerable.

To help grow and enhance the finance processes of the company, our client is looking for an experienced Assistant Accountant to fill a full-time position.

  • Fortnightly payroll and manual pay, as required
  • Maintaining fixed assets register and annual review
  • Maintaining staff accounts
  • Updating cashflow report on a weekly basis which includes updating for future import orders
  • Preparing Monthly retail reports

The successful applicant will preferably have:

  • Tertiary qualification in Business/Accounting
  • Sound knowledge of accounting/bookkeeping processes
  • At least 2 years’ experience in Assistant Accounting roles
  • Previous experience in supporting month-end closing, as well as general reporting
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • A high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Salary Package: $70k + benefits

OUR CLIENT

Our client is a multinational Technology Firm expanding rapidly in the APAC region, centered around Australia and New Zealand. Recently acquired by a major parent company and have plans to expand operations significantly in the next 5 years.

Our client is committed in nurturing and encouraging employees that allow them to reach their best potential in all facets of life.

job.title: Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

A well-known multinational construction and property business with expanding domestic operations and one of the best-performing divisions locally, with over eight $1 million+ brands and global sales of approximately $20 billion. The clients’ brands are truly global, with goods being manufactured and sold in more than 50 nations.

A close-knit, vibrant, and professional business culture takes pride in ensuring that working is a fulfilling and supportive experience. If you are prepared to shape the future and leave a legacy, join our team as an Accounts Receivable Officer.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Accounts Receivable Officer will be responsible for the company’s accounts receivable transactions and debt recovery. Previous experience in accounts receivable is essential. Experience in a construction company would be an advantage.

Key tasks and responsibilities:

●     Daily & weekly billing runs
●     Managing email & phone-based queries
●     Daily Forecast (Actuals vs Forecast) reporting
●     Running of receivable reports
●     Follow up on current and overdue accounts
●     End of month duties
●     Investigating and resolving queries relation to non-payment
●     Account reconciliations/Ledgers/Debt Collection & Allocations
●     Time efficiency
●     Working to monthly and annually collections targets

ABOUT YOU:
 
●     Three years minimum of equivalent experience within the Construction industry or Credit Control/Accounts Receivable
●     Prior knowledge of end-to-end receivables
●     Proficient with Salesforce
●     Solid AU based Credit Control/Accounts experience
●     Methodical worker and calm under pressure
●     Strong attention to detail and accuracy
●     Excellent verbal and written communication skills
●     Ability to multi-task and to meet deadlines
●     Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential
●     Ability to work co-operatively and effectively as part of a team/autonomously

WHAT WE OFFER

Our client is always on the lookout for great people. People who are driven, ambitious, have a track record of success, and are skilled at what they do. Benefits include:
 
●     Flexible working arrangements
●     Opportunities to grow your career
●     Private health insurance and wellness programs
●     Salary ($90,000-&105,000 based on experience)

job.description:
OUR CLIENT

One of the country’s leading charitable organisations, our client is committed to assisting those in need throughout the country and, in collaboration with other non-for-profit networks, around the globe. Our client is dedicated to the diversity of our staff, programs, and services.

The client has seen significant growth over the last decade and wants to extend its domestic operations even more. Going through a rapid growth, we are seeking an experienced Financial Accountant to join the team. Join us in this fantastic job opportunity if you share our enthusiasm for helping people. Work in an industry that advances the greater good.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Reporting directly to an experienced Finance Manager, you will be responsible for driving the monthly and annual processes, whilst supporting continuous improvement and more ad-hoc business projects as they arise.

Key duties and responsibilities include:

  • Preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual reports
  • Monitoring and reporting on accounting inconsistencies
  • Keeping up-to-date with financial policies, practices, and regulations
  • Complying with state and federal tax regulations
  • Preparing and delivering bank and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Manage intercompany process including reporting
  • File GST, NRWT and statistical returns
  • Assist in annual budgets and forecasts as well as internal and external audits


ABOUT YOU

You will be a qualified Chartered Accountant with over 2 years post-qualification experience, have strong financial accounting experience, and the ability to work at pace but still be accurate and have attention to detail. You will be system savvy and can work with large data sets. Working knowledge of the property and real estate industry is advantageous. You have advanced skills with the Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel, and the ability to work toward tight timelines. You are highly flexible. Operational flexibility will be required to meet business needs.

Salary Package: $100k + benefits

job.title: Junior Auditor
job.description:
ABOUT THE FIRM

Based In Perth, this BRW Top 20 Firm with a national presence paired alongside modern/luxurious offices in all major metropolitan cities. With a strong national presence working alongside clients with an annual turnover of up to 500 million this firm is looking to continue its consistent year-on-year growth through growing its business services department with a strong focus towards advisory work. The firm works alongside ASX-listed companies and offers a wide array of exposure to complex matters whilst maintaining a strong training support network for new employees. With regimented structure and clear-cut progression through to management, this firm is looking to bring on board a motivated accountant looking to progress their career to the next level.

WHAT DOES THE ROLE CONSIST OF   

  • Assist experienced senior auditors from planning to completion
  • External Audit and Assurance 
  • Assisting with the management of client relationships-  Report Writing  
  • Lead Engagements 
  • Assist in audit fieldwork  
  • Financial statements and tax compliance audits in line with the Australian Auditing and Accounting Standards 
  • Governance and regulatory compliance
  • Provide assistance with office administration

BENEFITS

  • Strong path of progression through to senior auditor
  • Parking on premises provided
  • Work alongside ex-big four partners
  • Full CA Support
  • BRW Top 20 firm with modern, luxury offices located in the Perth CBD
  • 80-staff firm with 10 Partners
  • Salary package 65k-70k, depending on experience

job.title: Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an established leader in the technology sector, with solid reputation in the Australian market and has been operating for 30 years with over 20 offices and 500+ staff all over the country. If you want to advance your career through learning and developing your financial knowledge, this is the opportunity you’ve been looking for!

The team has a strong, close-knit culture that values flexibility and mentoring. An option to work part-time from home for experienced applicants.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As the Accounts Receivable Officer, reporting to Chief Financial Officer and Finance Manager, you will be responsible for both the beginning phases of the debt collection process and the entire receivables department. Among the responsibilities are:

  • Daily processing of all bank receipts ensuring accurate and complete allocation of all customer and general ledger receipts.
  • Addressing and responding to customer inquiries and following up as required with internal staff.
  • Reconciliation of customer accounts and follow up where required.
  • Providing weekly performance reports of accounts receivable process.
  • Managing the monthly reconciliation of control accounts.
  • Follow up overdue invoices for allocated customer accounts
  • Process the receipt of customers payments in the accounting systems
  • Provide Ageing reports of overdue payments to Finance manager on daily, weekly, monthly basis
  • Any ad hoc as required by the Management

ABOUT YOU
﻿
  • Diploma / Certificate / Tertiary qualifications in Commerce or Accounting
  • Prior experience in financial roles is desirable
  • Experience in working within high volume environments
  • Knowledge of relevant accounting software
  • Proficient English communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work under pressure
  • Fluent in English – both written and spoken
  • Ability to work towards a deadline
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
  • Full working rights in Australia
  • Salary Package: $70k + benefits

job.title: Credit Control Officer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Established 20 years ago, our client is rapidly expanding supermarket retail chain in Australia and has recently opened a division in New Zealand. Given the company's current phase of expansion, the client is looking for a Credit Control Officer who can handle a fast-paced corporate environment and is forward-thinking and driven.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Credit Control Officer works in close with the Accounts Receivable team. The key additional duties of the role will include:

  • Assist with Detailed weekly or monthly reporting on all overdue accounts, together with assisting the team to action overdue accounts
  • Manage Overdue debtors, complex dispute resolutions, debt collection and negotiate payment plans
  • Ensure debtors are tightly managed, reporting on debtor balances and KPI’s, highlighting high risk accounts to ensure a reduction in debtors DSO
  • Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve a positive outcome in the debt collection process
  • Additional ad-hoc duties as required

ABOUT YOU

  • Bachelor’s degree level qualified in Finance required
  • Experience in a full-function accounts receivable/collections role in a financial firm is ideal
  • Experience in a large debt collection environment, high volume, and high value
  • Knowledge of complex ERP systems
  • Excellent communication & stakeholder management skills
  • Advanced level proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel and Word)

Salary package: $80k Package + Benefits

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Our client is an Australian group who operate businesses in renewable and sustainability sector with 30 offices and 10,000+ staff in the country. Our client is constantly evolving through the years, extending, and updating their range of resources to make them more dependable, useful, and cost-effective. As our client continues to demonstrate, no one should ever be compelled to choose between economical, dependable, or sustainable energy.

To help grow and enhance the finance processes of the company, our client is looking for an experienced Assistant Accountant to fill a full-time position.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Joining their growing finance team, you'll take responsibility for the full AR/AP function and assist on EOM/BAS reporting. All other tasks include, but not limited to:

  • Accounts Payable and Receivable Management
  • Assisting with balance sheet reconciliation
  • Preparing GST returns
  • Daily reconciliation of sales to banking and bank reconciliations for all entities
  • Fortnightly payroll and manual pay, as required
  • Maintaining fixed assets register and annual review
  • Maintaining staff accounts
  • Updating cashflow report on a weekly basis which includes updating for future import orders
  • Preparing Monthly retail reports

ABOUT YOU

The successful applicant will preferably have:

  • Tertiary qualification in Business/Accounting
  • Sound knowledge of accounting/bookkeeping processes
  • At least 2 years’ experience in Assistant Accounting roles
  • Previous experience in supporting month-end closing, as well as general reporting
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • A high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Salary Package: $70k + benefits
